old_problem: The nBIF command's iohub_instance field, group11/struct4 and errortype0 are proprietary and unmapped; threshold encoding and exact corrected-source/count plus attached-I/O oracle are absent.
disposition_reason: Standard MCA cannot decode AMD --nbionbif parser fields, internal structures or tool flags. These and FF5/FFE determine the target, stimulus, escalation and rollback, so they cannot be reduced to runtime parameters. ED-03/11/15/16 forbid guessing. Pending/BLOCKED remains until vendor mapping and a platform-specific I/O recovery contract exist.

test_case.test_name: nBIF parity CE containment and dependent-I/O validation
test_case.purpose: Inject one authoritative correctable parity event into each approved nBIF structure, prove the exact corrected MCA/WHEA source/count and no-reset containment, and preserve every attached PCIe path before exact restoration.
required_package: nBIF source/status/count plus attached-I/O health oracle
OOB recovery and exact Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not alter threshold or inject. After approval, inventory the nBIF and downstream devices, capture raw state/counters, apply only the documented threshold mask, inject one mapped target once, collect exact corrected source/count and all dependent link health, then restore/compare full state.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one fresh corrected event identifies the intended nBIF source and counter within timeout; no UCE/fatal, SyncFlood, reset, retrain or downstream device/service loss occurs; all controls and links equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until option/tuple/flag/threshold semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic parity text, wrong source, missing count, hidden link degradation, reset or imperfect restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with OOB and downstream dependency inventory.
No raw write without definition/mask and saved full value.
One nBIF event at a time; abort on wrong source, storm, escalation, reset or device loss.
No automatic retry; preserve counters and link evidence.
test_case.recovery: Stop injector, preserve MCA/link evidence, restore complete threshold and Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT state, recover affected PCIe paths through the approved OOB plan and verify every dependent service. Execution remains blocked until approved.
